agentSessionKey.title: Agent Session Key
agentSessionKey.description: Stable agent session key if available. Pass automatically from session context. Do not ask the user.

answerCapture.title: Answer Capture
answerCapture.description: Legacy structured answer capture. Leave blank for Enhanced Chat; use Answer Value as the user-provided answer.

answersJson.title: Answers JSON
answersJson.description: Current accumulated answers JSON. Pass from the latest SmartIntake action output. Do not ask the user.

answerValue.title: Answer Value
answerValue.description: The user's answer to the currently displayed SmartIntake question. Use the latest user message or selected value from the rendered question control.

intakeSessionId.title: Intake Session Id
intakeSessionId.description: Current SmartIntake session id. Pass from the latest SmartIntake action output. Do not ask the user.

routableId.title: Routable Id
routableId.description: Messaging session or voice call record id. Pass from system context when available.

smartIntakeContextKey.title: SmartIntake Context Key
smartIntakeContextKey.description: Route key for SmartIntake. Set from $Context.Current_Page so Apex can resolve the template from routing metadata. Do not ask the user.
